name: spain-tax-optimization
description: Use this skill whenever asked about reducing tax in Spain, tax planning, saving tax, optimizing tax, allowances, deductions the client might be missing, or any question about legal strategies to minimize income tax liability for self-employed individuals (autónomos) in Spain. Trigger on phrases like "reduce tax", "tax planning", "save tax", "optimize", "allowances", "deductions I'm missing", "pagar menos impuestos", "optimización fiscal", "ahorrar en impuestos", "deducciones IRPF", "autónomo fiscal". It covers the common-regime IRPF, estimación directa and módulos, autónomo or SL, RETA, IVA, pensions and the LGT arts 15 and 16 limits, with filing on the AEAT Sede and Import@ss. ALWAYS read this skill before advising on any Spanish tax optimization strategy. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise a tax position.
